description: [Screener Desk] Ranks fAlpha's covered universe (5k+ US equities) by the current signal, either the equity indicator or the signal's realized Sharpe ratio, filtered by direction, sector or a minimum Sharpe ratio. Names that share the top value are listed by ticker and the result says how many share it (`tied_at_top`). For questions like 'which tech names lean long'. Available on fAlpha Professional, Premium and Enterprise plans.

direction.description: Restrict results to one side of the signal.
direction.title: Direction

horizon.description: Holding period the reading is for, in trading days: hp5d (5), hp15d (15), hp2m (42, about two calendar months).
horizon.title: Horizon

min_sharpe.description: Minimum realized Sharpe ratio a name needs to be included.
min_sharpe.title: Min Sharpe

rank_by.description: Ranking measure: ei (the equity indicator, signed) or sharpe (the signal's realized Sharpe ratio).
rank_by.title: Rank By

regime.description: Market backdrop the model conditions on: neutral (no market view), bull or bear.
regime.title: Regime

sector.description: GICS sector name, e.g. 'Information Technology'. Without it, every sector is included.
sector.title: Sector

top_k.description: How many names to return. Capped at 25.
top_k.title: Top K

name: falpha_screener_desk
title: Screen the covered universe
